sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं तं शूरमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम्।द्रवमाणास्ततो वाक्यमूचुः शूरविगर्हितम् ।। ६.६६.२९ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ taṁ śūramaṅgadaṁ kanakāṅgadam।dravamāṇāstato vākyamūcuḥ śūravigarhitam ।। 6.66.29 ।।

translations.english: While the heroic Angada, adorned with gold armlets, was speaking in that manner to the fleeing vanara heroes, condemned by the hero the vanaras replied as follows.
